title: Unitary dilation and the Crouzeix–Palencia bound
abstract: Proves unitary power dilation for Hilbert-space contractions, von Neumann’s polynomial inequality, and the Crouzeix–Palencia polynomial spectral-set estimate for the closed numerical range.

informal.PalomarCrouzeixPalencia.exists_unitary_p: Every contraction on a complex Hilbert space admits a unitary power dilation.
informal.PalomarCrouzeixPalencia.vonNeumann_inequ: Polynomial evaluation on a contraction is bounded by the polynomial supremum on the closed unit disk.
informal.PalomarCrouzeixPalencia.crouzeix_palenci: The closure of the numerical range is a polynomial spectral set with constant 1 + √2.
